read: US500, time taken back to 09:54. This was a read and a lesson, not an order: I never set a sell limit on US500, so there is no entry or stop to show.
What was there: Monday's untouched 4h bearish gap (7,436.8–7,483.9), and three equal highs built right against its lower edge. The 06:00–07:00 rally stopped at 7,435.4, under them.
Sharif at 08:45–08:50: US100 ate its highs and sold; US500 created liquidity (left its highs). "If price wanted to sell from here it could": it can eat liquidity and then sell, or create it and sell.
What it did: it never went back for those highs. From 7,435 it reached the London low (10:31), last week's low (10:40) and November's low (10:54), low 7,288.2.
At the prep I had written "sell = with the weekly and daily" and was waiting for the highs to be swept into the gap. That wait was the mistake: the sweep is never a condition.
